purpose: Define deterministic precedence/merge semantics across explicit configuration layers without filesystem/load-order dependence.

topics.name: Configuration Precedence Resolution
topics.purpose: Define deterministic precedence/merge semantics across explicit configuration layers without filesystem/load-order dependence.

semantics.field_rule: Per-field merge/override semantics may be explicit.
semantics.order_rule: Layer precedence is declarative and independent of discovery/file order.
semantics.conflict_rule: Incompatible same-precedence values produce explicit conflict.
semantics.null_rule: Unset/null/default semantics follow exact field rules.
semantics.security_rule: Protected values cannot be weakened through unauthorized lower layer.
semantics.evidence_rule: Effective value can be traced to source layers.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: environment overrides IAM assurance policy unintentionally
